column5: vielsprachig (Adj.) and die Mehrsprachigkeit (N.) are different POS. Two linked typed units, not one learner card.

Vielsprachigkeit and Mehrsprachigkeit overlap generally. In specialized education, Vielsprachigkeit is societal coexistence versus individual Mehrsprachigkeit; not a categorical general-language rule.
